title: Use a provider-neutral local agent interface
decision: Archivist should define a provider-neutral local agent interface, with an LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible local endpoint as the first adapter.
context: The old EPP manual browser used a local LM Studio-style bridge. The standalone Archivist app should preserve the local chat/manual-agent behavior without making the old bridge shape the permanent product contract.
rationale: The durable contract is that a local agent can read the current view, follow selected-text instructions, generate reviewable proposals, queue pending reviews, expose provider status, and leave inspectable diagnostics. The specific model provider should remain replaceable plumbing.
alternatives_considered: Make the old LM Studio bridge the long-term Archivist contract
Design around a cloud provider from the start
Defer the provider interface until after chat UI is rebuilt
consequences: SG-0004 no longer needs provider-shape grilling
Future providers can be added behind the same local agent interface without changing review and audit workflows
